label_origin: team judgement from report text; held-out set, labelled before any module run
trl_rationale: A subscale system prototype flew on a suborbital sounding rocket, deployed and flew free to Mach 3.09 with full trajectory reconstruction. That is a relevant flight environment but not full-scale planetary entry heating, so 6 rather than 7.

evidence.quote: Specifically, the ADEPT SR-1 mission tested a 0.7 meter deployable heat shield from a sounding rocket launch vehicle.
The vehicle was delivered within the nominal flight envelope by the launch provider and achieved a maximum Mach number and dynamic pressure of 3.09 and 818.4 Pa respectively.
The vehicle was successfully released from the sounding rocket approximately 96 seconds after launch.

review_notes: TRL 7 arguable if suborbital flight counts as operational; the paper is about trajectory reconstruction, not heatshield performance.
